panel.summary: `NoteEditorAPI.undo()/redo()` still mutate the store on a read-only mount; only the keymap path is guarded
panel.evidence: packages/notes/src/view/editor.ts:213 skips the history keymap when `readOnly`, and editor.ts:49-52 checks `EditorView.editable` before routing vim keys, but the public API entry points (editor.ts:431 `undo: () => runHistory('undo')`) apply no such check and reach `store.undo()` directly. The current caller, packages/frontend/src/app/notes/notes-toolbar.tsx:200 (`canFormat = !readOnly && mode !== 'view'`), hides the buttons, so the bypass is not reachable today — but the guard added in this change is inconsistent across entry points and a future host calling `editor.undo()` would write on a read-only share.
